description: This file defines a custom HTML element 'doxygen-awesome-dark-mode-toggle' that provides a toggle button for switching between light and dark modes on a website. It includes SVG icons, manages user and system preferences, and updates the webpage's theme accordingly.

classes.name: DoxygenAwesomeDarkModeToggle
classes.description: A custom HTML element that provides a toggle button for switching between light and dark themes, managing user preferences and system settings.

methods.name: toggleDarkMode
methods.description: Toggles the user preference for dark mode and updates the icon accordingly.

methods.name: updateIcon
methods.description: Updates the toggle button icon based on the current theme state.
